canonical_statement: For a suitable weak solution of the three-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations, the singular set has one-dimensional parabolic Hausdorff measure zero (with regularity on its complement), under the precise local hypotheses of the primary CKN theorem.
domain_and_universes: Classical root concerns velocity u and pressure p on an open subset of R^3 x R; exact function/distribution spaces and Lean universes remain to be frozen from the primary source.
quantifiers: every suitable weak solution (u,p) satisfying the source theorem's local hypotheses
space-time points and positive radii used by the local regularity criterion
hypotheses: three-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations in the weak sense
domain and locality conditions from the primary theorem
conclusion: The singular set has zero one-dimensional parabolic Hausdorff measure; equivalently credited regularity claims must use the source's definitions and cannot substitute Euclidean Hausdorff measure.

alternate_encodings.relationship: candidate proof architecture for the root conclusion
